instructions.question: What overall sentiment does the tweet's author express or convey about its topic: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Positive needs explicit enthusiasm, praise or celebration, or news of an achievement, honour, win or welcome development for a favoured team, artist or product. Negative covers complaints, disappointment, anger, mockery, personal mishaps, and any report of violence, attacks, injuries or criminal charges, even plainly worded. Neutral covers ads, event listings, invitations, check-ins and plans without explicit excitement, plus plain news, analytical commentary, questions, mixed views and light jokes about trivial matters.

neutral.what: Ads, event listings, invitations and plans without explicit feeling; news with no harm or achievement; analytical opinions on teams or politicians; mixed views; joking gripes about trivial matters.
examples: Make sure you buy tickets for Mobtown Moon Preview at Creative Alliance on Sat, Sep 8 !
Going to see Paper Towns on Saturday. I'm hoping it does the book justice.
Fake punt on 4th and 11? Wow, James Franklin can make some odd decisions. #PennState #Michigan #PSUvsMICH
neutral.cues: don't miss, get ready, register, tickets, I'm going to, who wants to, may, reportedly, scores
neutral.not_for: Violence, injuries or charges (negative); achievements or explicit delight (positive).

positive.what: Explicit excitement, praise, love, hope or celebration, and good news such as achievements, nominations, top rankings, wins or welcome releases.
examples: Can't wait to see you tomorrow at The Roxy!
David Price is the fastest #bluejays' pitcher to reach 50Ks with the team.
I just saw a glance at the new Galaxy Note 5. Looks interesting. That may be my next phone.
positive.cues: can't wait, love, excited, great, interesting, nomination, 1st place, record, finally, !!
positive.not_for: Ads, 'don't miss' promos, 'I'm going to X' check-ins, 'who wants to come' questions (neutral); sarcastic praise (negative).

negative.what: Sadness, anger, frustration, disappointment, insults, mockery, personal mishaps and annoyances, and reports of violence, attacks, injuries, crashes or charges.
examples: still so sad I'm not going to Ed Sheeran the 25th :////
Day 2 stuck in the Taipei airport. Possibly going to LA to wait out the storm. Didn't think I'd make it to Cali for the 1st time this way
RT @user Gavin Henson looks set to miss the Rugby World Cup after dislocating a bone in his right wrist yesterday
negative.cues: sad, bored, tedious, stuck, lost, hate, worst, pathetic, wtf, :/, :(, attack, injured, charged
negative.not_for: Calm analysis of a team or politician, joking gripes about one's evening (neutral).
